question: Why does an 8-step turbo generation lose detail partway through a clip when the first frame handed in is sharp?

setup.note: one variable changed per cell, same prompt and seed throughout, n=1

metric: Laplacian variance at native resolution on the whole frame, sampled at the midpoint (frame 62) and the last frame (123)

cells.name: B_shift12
cells.delta_vs_baseline: identical to four significant figures; the node's default shift_video of 12.0 is already what the model uses, so adding it changes nothing

cells.name: D_slowcam
cells.delta_vs_baseline: mid +58.8%, end +112.8%, at the same cost

conclusion: Per-frame displacement, not step count and not the sigma shift, is what costs detail here. Removing the words fast / rushing / tearing past / rapid from the camera instruction more than doubled end-of-clip sharpness at identical cost.
limitations: n=1 per cell, one scene, one seed. The LoRA section of this repo is a worked example of an n=1 result reversing, so treat the magnitudes as provisional; the ordering was large enough to be visible without the metric.
